craft_notes: Sthāyin: letter-body (alphabet as limbs). Rows: row 2 (formed→wins). Close: wins (jayati as landing: she WINS — the verse's only verb of victory). Rejected: spelling the letters out — kept A/KA/ṬA/PĀ/ṂA/YA (the letters ARE the verse); 'goddess of learning' — kept Sarasvatī named (she is the point).

lines: A-first, KA-handed, ṬA-footed, PĀ-flanked with ṂA amid;
YA-hearted goddess, consciousness-formed — Sarasvatī, you win.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ādimukhā kādikarā ṭādipadā | pādipārśvayuṅmadhyā | yādihṛdayā bhagavatī saṃvidrūpā | sarasvatī jayati

reads_against.argmap: Who is enthroned? → The letter-body enthroned as goddess: alphabet limbs from A to YA, consciousness-formed Sarasvatī supreme over all.
